cycles.name: Project Setup & Architecture
goals: Initialize monorepo structure with client and server
Set up Vite + React frontend with Tailwind CSS
Set up Express backend with MongoDB connection
Configure Clerk authentication
Set up environment variables and .gitignore

cycles.name: User Authentication & Core Models
goals: Implement Clerk-based user authentication
Create User, Course, Purchase, and CourseProgress models
Set up Clerk webhooks for user lifecycle
Implement user data retrieval endpoints

cycles.name: Course Management (CRUD)
goals: Implement course creation with thumbnail upload via Cloudinary
Build course listing and detail endpoints
Add course content structure with chapters and lectures
Implement educator role assignment and protection

cycles.name: Student Enrollment & Progress Tracking
goals: Implement course purchase flow with Stripe checkout
Track student enrollment and course progress
Build lecture completion tracking
Implement user course progress retrieval

cycles.name: Payment Integration (Stripe)
goals: Integrate Stripe checkout for course purchases
Implement Stripe webhook handlers for payment success/failure
Update purchase status on payment completion
Enroll students in courses on successful payment
deliverables: Stripe checkout session creation in userController.js

cycles.name: Educator Dashboard & Analytics
goals: Build educator dashboard with total earnings, courses, and students
Implement enrolled students listing with purchase data
Add course rating and review system
Create educator-specific routes and middleware

cycles.name: Frontend UI & Student Pages
goals: Build student home page with course listings
Implement course detail and player pages
Create enrollment and progress tracking UI
Add search, filtering, and responsive design

cycles.name: Testing, Polish & Deployment
goals: Write tests for backend controllers and routes
End-to-end testing of key user flows
Performance optimization and bug fixes
Deploy to Vercel (frontend) and server (backend)
